_doc: The campaign's ground: engine theater id + fixed seed + the authored layout. The layout's town/feature NAMES are this campaign's GAZETTEER — missions reference them by name. Geography designed 2026-07-24 (layout-preview harness): the SE window of the chorwon patch — open southern valley walled by the HILL 894 ridge east, a major river system mid-map, opening north toward the plain. The town chain IS the campaign spine, south to north: ASHFORD (the lodgment fight) -> BREVIK (river crossing) -> CALDER (crossroads) -> DORAN (valley mouth) -> the enemy base on the northern edge; ELMSTED hangs west off the MSR as a flank objective. ASHFORD sits 3.1 km up the MSR (~4x the garrison's 800 m envelope, the MSR bridge 1.35 km short of town). Roads/hamlets/features still generate procedurally from these nodes.
